problem:
Which of the matrices below does **not** have an inverse?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
- The matrix $A$ is a $1\times 2$ matrix. So, it is not invertible.

- For the matrix $B$, we have

$$
det(B)=0\cdot 0-(-1)\cdot 1=1.
$$

Because $det(B)\ne 0,$ we conclude that $B$ is invertible.

- For the matrix $C$, we have

$$
det(C)=1\cdot 2-2\cdot 1=0.
$$

Because $det(C)=0,$ we conclude that $C$ is not invertible.

Therefore, only $A$ and $C$ do not have an inverse.
